title: Most students walk through campus trying to survive.
paragraphs: Most students walk through campus trying to survive.
Few walk through campus carrying revival.

📖 NEW RELEASE:
“How to Start a Campus Ministry from Zero”
This is not a motivational Christian book.
This is a wake-up call.

Because too many believers are waiting for:
❌ confidence
❌ permission
❌ support
❌ a big opportunity
Meanwhile people around them are silently drowning spiritually.
Your campus does not need another passive Christian.
It needs disciples who are willing to pray, lead, and speak truth with love.
🔥 THIS BOOK WILL CHALLENGE YOU
You’ve been taught that influence starts with popularity.

But in Scripture…
revival usually started with one surrendered person.

One prayer meeting.
One Bible study.
One obedient “yes” to God.

This book will show you how to start even if:
• nobody supports you
• you feel unqualified
• you’ve never led before
• your school feels spiritually dead
• you’re afraid of rejection

✅ How to start a Bible study from zero
✅ How to gather students naturally without hype
✅ How to evangelize without sounding weird or aggressive
✅ How to build a real discipleship culture
✅ How to overcome fear, discouragement, and rejection
✅ How to raise leaders instead of building a personality-driven ministry
✅ How to stay spiritually strong while serving publicly
⚔️ MOST PEOPLE VS FEW PEOPLE

Most people want comfort.
Few people want calling.

Most believers stay silent.
Few are willing to stand for Jesus publicly.

Most students blend in.
Few become light in dark places.

The question is:
Which one are you becoming?
🔥 THIS IS BIGGER THAN A BOOK
And growing almost daily.

Not casual scrolling.
Not entertainment Christianity.
This is for believers who are serious about growth, obedience, discipline, and impact.

If you feel God calling you deeper…
this is your invitation.
The next revival may not start from a stage.
It may start from one surrendered student.
